text:
marta: T-20 to liftoff: final flight-deck checklist. Posting quick bullets and ask for GO/NO-GO. Keep replies terse.

marta: TL;DR: quiet window starts at T+5m for 45m, pinned model for canary = v4.0.0-rc1, canary slice = 8% traffic EU, gradual ramp plan in release doc: https://internal/release/flightdeck-2026-03-21.

josh: smoke passed on staging. small tokenization diff flagged but accepted in evals.

li: infra look: pools warmed, prefetch jobs completed. I bumped canary timeout to 7s from 9s for noisy clients.

kevin: noted. added rollback command to runbook.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary-init -> creating pool: gpu-slice-eu-small
```
deploy-bot: INIT canary service=redwood-inference version=v4.0.0-rc1 target=8% region=eu-west-1
```

rhea: oncall: I kicked KV prefix cache prime for hot prefixes and seeded 8M warm tokens. watching memory.

marta: rollback triggers (flight-deck shorthand):
- auto: error-rate > 2.5% sustained 180s OR 5xx spike > 4x baseline
- perf: p95 > 600ms sustained 5m -> pause ramp and evaluate
- safety: content-safety regression hit -> immediate rollback and notify legal
- cost: sustained >12% cost increase for 30m -> pause and investigate (no auto-rollback)

li: adding: if autoscale fails to add nodes within 2m and p95 rising -> manual hold.

josh: quick canary probe (example):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.internal/api/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: Redwood","max_tokens":12}'
```
returns 200 and short summary.

kevin: I posted the exact emergency unpin steps in docs and included system commands. Also: `deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-inference --to v3.9.8 --reason "safety-or-perf"` in runbook.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary ramp: 0% -> 8% target achieved. cache_warm=8M tokens.

marta: quick ask: who is the final launch conductor to greenlight 100% after ramps?

josh: final conductor = marta or kevin if I'm unreachable.

li: monitoring: p95 140ms, errors 0.3%, infra mem stable. small kernel-selection warn but no failures.

rhea: got a small retry blip at +4m from an external client. retries x2 for ~40s then resolved. no user impact seen.

marta: quiet window note: no config infra changes for 45m once window starts. deploys to other services OK but avoid network/route edits.

kevin: documented. will not touch infra during quiet.

oncall-bot: [oncall-bot] status-check: no Sev1 open in last 24h. current pager: rhea. if rollback -> alert #release-war-room and tag @marta @josh.

marta: calling conditional GO to begin staged ramp to 30% at T+25m if metrics hold. final GO call at T+25m here.

josh: I give conditional GO. hold for T+25m signal.

rhea: watching dashboards, will DM if anything breaches thresholds. posting watch links to #incidents.

marta: thanks team 1 — reconvene T+25m in this thread with short status. keep channels clear. :ok_hand:
